village_elder.name: Village Elder Mira
village_elder.description: Wise keeper of Oakrest Village. Worried about the wolves creeping too close to town.

dialogue.greeting: Traveler! The forest wolves grow bold. Will you thin their numbers?
dialogue.quest_offer: Hunt 3 Forest Wolves in Mosswood Forest and return to me.
dialogue.quest_active: The wolves still prowl. Return when 3 have fallen.
dialogue.quest_complete: You have done Oakrest a great service. Take this, and welcome.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith Dorn
blacksmith.description: Grizzled smith who sells basic gear to those who can pay.

dialogue.greeting: Need steel, traveler? I've wares for those with coin.
dialogue.shop: Take a look. Prices are fair.
